title: 第23章 小女子沈清漪第24章 赶集赚钱
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
弓入手，熟悉的感觉瞬间归来。
虽是把劣弓，但此刻在他手中，不啻于神兵利器！
他脚跟尚未站稳，搭箭、开弓、瞄准，三个动作在电光石火间一气呵成，弓弦震响。
箭矢离弦，直扑那持棍匪徒空门大开的胸膛！
“噗嗤！”
箭矢入肉，那匪徒惨叫着倒退。
“点子硬！
并肩子上！”
匪徒头目是个满脸横肉的疤脸汉子，见状又惊又怒。
挥舞着一柄锈迹斑斑的腰刀，带着剩余三人猛扑上来，企图近身混战。
李玄且战且退，步伐灵动如狐，总在间不容发之际避开劈砍。
手中猎弓时而如短棍格挡，时而抓住空隙闪电般射出一箭。
又一名匪徒大腿中箭，踉跄倒地。
李忠和王氏躲在远处石头后，看得心惊胆战，手脚冰凉。
却又见李玄竟真以一敌众不落下风，心中骇然之余，也生出一丝渺茫的希望。
“别管这煞星！
先抓后面那两个！”
疤脸头目见李玄难缠，目光转向李忠夫妇藏身之处，面露凶光。
李玄眼神一寒，知道不能再拖。
他猛地将猎弓往地上一插，俯身再次抓起两块石头。

左右开弓，凭借惊人的力量和准头狠狠掷出！
一块砸翻了冲向李忠方向的匪徒，另一块逼得疤脸头目挥刀格挡，铛啷作响。
趁此间隙，李玄再次拾弓搭箭，这一次，他瞄准了稍远处那个一直试图用投石索骚扰、威胁最大的匪徒。
弓开如满月，箭出似流星！
“嗖——噗！”
箭矢精准地没入那匪徒咽喉，他捂着脖子，嗬嗬作响地瘫软下去。
眨眼间，六名匪徒已去其四，只剩疤脸头目和一个手臂受伤的匪徒。
两人已被李玄的凶悍和精准吓破了胆，尤其是看到同伴咽喉中箭的惨状，斗志全消。
“风紧！
扯呼！”
疤脸头目虚晃一刀，转身就想往林子深处逃。
“现在想走？晚了！”
李玄声音冰冷。
他深知乱世匪徒最为记仇，若放虎归山，后患无穷。
更别说，方才隐约听到的孩童啼哭与女子尖叫，表明这些匪徒还劫掠了其他人，罪恶更不可恕。
他深吸一口气，灵巧属性全力催动，疾步追上，手中最后一支箭稳稳搭上弓弦。
奔跑中，他身形依然稳定如山岳，目光锁定了疤脸头目踉跄奔逃的背影。
弓弦再响！
箭矢从后背贯入，前胸透出少许箭镞，疤脸头目向前扑倒，抽搐两下便不动了。
最后那名受伤匪徒吓得魂飞魄散，跪地连连磕头求饶。

李玄走上前，面无表情地看着他。
那匪徒涕泪横流：
“好汉饶命！
content_en:
As soon as I took the bow, the familiar feeling returned instantly.
Although it is an inferior bow, in his hands at this moment, it is nothing less than a magical weapon!
Before he could stand firmly on his feet, he nocked the arrow, fired the bow, and aimed. The three actions were completed in a flash of lightning, and the bowstring vibrated.
The arrow left the string and hit the open chest of the stick-wielding gangster!
"Pfft!"
The arrow penetrated the flesh, and the gangster screamed and retreated.
"Hard idea!
Side by side! "
The gangster leader was a scarred man with a sinister face. He was shocked and angry when he saw this.
Wielding a rusty waist knife, he and the remaining three people swooped forward, trying to get close to each other in a melee.
Li Xuan fights and retreats at the same time, his steps are as nimble as a fox, and he always avoids slashing when there is no chance to make a move.
The hunting bow in his hand sometimes blocks like a short stick, and sometimes seizes the gap and shoots an arrow like lightning.
Another gangster was hit by an arrow in the thigh and staggered to the ground.
Li Zhong and Wang hid behind rocks in the distance, looking frightened and their hands and feet were cold.
But when he saw that Li Xuan was actually able to defeat many enemies, he felt horrified but also had a faint hope.
"Don't worry about this evil star!
Grab the two at the back first! "
Seeing that Li Xuan was difficult to deal with, the scar-faced leader turned his eyes to where Li Zhong and his wife were hiding, with a fierce look on his face.
Li Xuan's eyes turned cold and he knew he couldn't delay it any longer.
He thrust the hunting bow into the ground suddenly, leaned over and grabbed two stones again.
Open the bow left and right, and throw it hard with amazing power and accuracy!
One piece knocked over the gangster who was rushing towards Li Zhong, and the other piece forced the scar-faced leader to block with his sword, making a clanging sound.
Taking advantage of this gap, Li Xuan picked up his bow and arrow again. This time, he aimed at the gangster a little further away who had been trying to harass him with a sling and was the greatest threat.
The bow opens like a full moon, and the arrow shoots out like a shooting star!
"Whoosh-poof!"
The arrow hit the gangster's throat accurately. He covered his neck and collapsed with a whooshing sound.
In the blink of an eye, four of the six gangsters were gone, leaving only the scarred leader and a gangster with an injured arm.
The two of them had been frightened by Li Xuan's ferocity and precision, especially when they saw the tragic situation of their companion with an arrow in his throat, their fighting spirit was completely gone.
“The wind is tight!
Shit! "
The scar-faced leader feinted with his knife, turned around and tried to escape deeper into the forest.
"Want to leave now? It's too late!"
Li Xuan's voice was cold.
He knows very well that in troubled times, gangsters are the most vengeful. If the tiger is allowed to return to the mountains, there will be endless troubles.
Not to mention, the faintly heard children crying and women screaming just now showed that these gangsters also robbed other people, and their crimes were even more unforgivable.
He took a deep breath, activated his dexterity attribute with all his strength, and quickly caught up with him. The last arrow in his hand was firmly placed on the bowstring.
While running, his figure remained as stable as a mountain, his eyes locked on the staggering running back of the scar-faced leader.
The bowstring rings again!
The arrow penetrated from the back, and a few arrowheads came out of the chest. The scar-faced leader fell forward, twitched twice and then stopped moving.
In the end, the injured gangster was so frightened that he knelt down and kowtowed repeatedly to beg for mercy.
Li Xuan stepped forward and looked at him expressionlessly.
The gangster burst into tears:
"Hero, spare your life!
